title: Studio shell header: the pillar segmented control and Changes overlap below 640 px
body:
## Source

Measured on objectui main `d4bc81eab` (after #12459 and #12452) in a 558 × 326 viewport: the shell header draws its three groups on one 48 px row; the segmented control's fourth segment (Access) sits under the Changes button and the Publish button is clipped at the right edge. The "Studio is built for a desktop screen" note (`engine.studio.desktopHint`) shows below the header, but the header itself is still broken. The header grid is `grid-cols-[1fr_auto_1fr]` from `studio-tokens.ts`; below `xl` the segments are icon-only already, which is not enough below `sm`.

## Target

1. Below the `sm` breakpoint (640 px) the header stacks: row one is home, app chip, Changes, Publish; row two is the segmented control at full width with icon-only segments. Nothing overlaps from 360 px to 640 px.
2. From `sm` to `xl` the single row stays with icon-only segments, as today; `xl` and above shows labels.
3. The mobile note stays as it is.

## File surface

`packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/StudioDesignSurface.tsx` (shell header), `studio-tokens.ts` (`STUDIO_HEADER`), a test beside them.

## Acceptance

1. Screenshots at 375 px and 560 px, light and dark: no overlap, Publish fully visible.
2. A test asserts the header's stacked classes below `sm` (the token string) and the single-row classes above.
3. `StudioDesignSurface.*.test.tsx` green.

## Constraints

- Tailwind utilities only.
- The More overflow does not return; objectui#12452's ruling stands.

<sub>Filed by the epic PM session `session_cdb7a717-def7-4e71-9988-f089fbaa18ff` from the 2026-10-15 Studio test pass: objectui main `d4bc81eab`, HotCRM `63db83e2`, the vite console on :5180 against `objectstack serve --dev` on :4001, viewport 1482 × 1119, dark theme with a light-theme check.</sub>

Parent: objectstack-ai/objectui#12446
